verdict.rationale: Vendor docs directly claim 'all packages, tools and runtimes ready with a single command' plus container tooling ready out-of-box, matching the story closely, but this is first-party marketing copy only with no independent corroboration or hands-on validation of the single-command claim. Community evidence is largely unrelated to dev tooling setup (desktop environment gripes, driver issues) and doesn't confirm or deny this specific capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the single-command install claim, specifics on which package manager/command is used, and confirmation from developer community that it works as advertised.
